traits.name: Darkvision
traits.desc: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.desc: As a Bonus Action, you take the Dash action and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Uses equal to your Proficiency Bonus (regained on a rest).

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.desc: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once per Long Rest.
